programme.desc: Struggente riflessione sulla vita premiata a Venezia. Il lavoro di John May e' organizzare il funerale delle persone morte in solitudine. Il suo ultimo incarico gli farà scoprire se stesso.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Non odiare
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Sara Serraiocco nell'opera prima di Mauro Mancini, ispirata a una storia vera. Un chirurgo ebreo lascia morire un uomo, ferito in un incidente, per una svastica tatuata sul petto. Turbato dai sensi di colpa, assume la figlia della vittima come colf.

programme.title: Il seme del fico sacro
programme.desc: Premio a Cannes e una candidatura agli Oscar per la coraggiosa opera di Mohammad Rasoulof. Nell'Iran delle proteste giovanili, l'unione di una famiglia viene messa a dura prova.

programme.title: Una figlia
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo cresce la figlia in simbiosi dopo la morte della moglie. Quando cerca di ricostruirsi una vita con una nuova compagna, la reazione della figlia metterà a dura prova il suo amore paterno e la sua capacità di perdonare.

programme.desc: 7 David di Donatello per l'opera di Maura Delpero premiata anche a Venezia. La Seconda guerra mondiale volge al termine quando la stabilità di una famiglia trentina è stravolta.

programme.desc: Grand Prix della Giuria a Cannes per il pluripremiato Asghar Farhadi. Un detenuto rinuncia a una borsa piena d'oro restituendola al proprietario. Diventera' un eroe ma con esiti imprevisti.

programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l'Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.desc: Toni Servillo e Silvio Orlando nel dramma carcerario di Leonardo Di Costanzo che indaga il delicato rapporto tra secondini e detenuti, premiato con 2 David di Donatello 2022.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Liev Schreiber nel cult on the road con Elijah Wood. Un giovane americano intraprende un viaggio in Ucraina alla ricerca della donna che salvò suo nonno dai nazisti.

programme.desc: Riccardo Scamarcio e Lou de Laage nell'opera prima di Stephane Freiss. Una giovane, di famiglia ebrea ortodossa, incontra un uomo con cui esplora il desiderio di ribellarsi alla tradizione.

programme.title: Anime nere
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Gioacchino Criaco, un viaggio infernale nel cuore della 'Ndrangheta. In un paesino dell'Aspromonte, l'atto intimidatorio del ventenne Leo nei confronti di un clan rivale riunisce dopo molti anni tre fratelli. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.title: Uno di noi
programme.desc: Kevin Costner e Diane Lane in un dramma dai risvolti thrilling. Uno sceriffo e la moglie lasciano il ranch nel Montana per salvare la nuora e il nipote da una famiglia di criminali.

programme.title: Hey Joe
programme.desc: Claudio Giovannesi dirige James Franco in una pellicola sulle conseguenze dei conflitti. Venticinque anni dopo, il veterano Dean torna a Napoli alla ricerca del figlio.

programme.title: La paranza dei bambini
programme.desc: Miglior sceneggiatura a Berlino 2019 per il film di Claudio Giovannesi tratto dal bestseller di Roberto Saviano. Napoli: l'ascesa di un gruppo di giovanissimi nel mondo della criminalita'.

programme.desc: Andrea Carpenzano nel film Sky Original di Francesco Lettieri. L'ascesa e il declino di Nic, in arte Lovely Boy, astro nascente della scena musicale romana finito nel baratro della droga.

programme.title: Top Chef S17
programme.desc: Fifteen of the competition’s fiercest challengers return to face-off in the toughest season yet! A mise-en-place challenge set at the historic Griffith Observatory in Los Angeles kicks off the intense battle, where the Chefs immediately size each other up to see how everyone has progressed since last competing. Then, the first elimination challenge takes the Chefs to the beach to cook a seafood meal – however, their only heat source will be fire. No electricity, no special appliances. Back to basics. It’s going to be a true slug-match to see who has the skills and who has the drive to take the one thing that has eluded them all… the title of Top Chef! Padma Lakshmi, Tom Colicchio, and Gail Simmons return as judges and joining them as the first guest judge of the season is legendary Chef, Jeremiah Tower. Marcus Samuelsson, Nancy Silverton, Michael Cimarusti, Josiah Citrin, Suzanne Goin, Caroline Styne share the table for the high-powered, high-stress beach-side meal.

programme.title: Top Chef S17
programme.desc: This week the chefs honor the late, great Pulitzer-Prize winning food critic Jonathan Gold. Using Gold’s last guide list, the chefs fan out all over Los Angeles to sample the unique taquerias, food trucks, mom-and-pop cafes, upscale eateries and ethnic cuisine only found in the City of Angels. Drawing inspiration from this one-in-a-lifetime culinary odyssey, the chefs create dishes to serve 200 of Jonathan Gold’s friends, family, and restaurateurs that he loved at the iconic Union Station. Noted food writer and personal friend of Jonathan Gold, Ruth Reichl serves as guest judge alongside Padma, Tom and Gail.

programme.title: Momshies! Ang Soul Mo'y Akin
programme.desc: Three women with totally different lives accidentally get their souls switched as they struggle with the comedic misadventures of their new worlds, they realize that their own lives and families are worth loving and living for. Jolene, a famous person who always has fans in public, Mylene - an overprotected lady who always gets pleasure and love and Karlene - a rich famous social media influencer all switch bodies but their lives did not just change, but their souls switched that leaves them with no choice but to stick together to live the peculiar lives of each other. Karlene then has to convince a group of investors to invest in her near-bankrupt hotel, but no one believes her because she is trapped in Mylene’s body. In the process of all of their imaginative scenarios, they drew closer to each other into becoming the soul sisters they are destined to be.

From that day on Lion always roars with pride, showing any beast who's the real King of Tinga Tinga. Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales

One day, Eagle arrives at the Watering Hole with a new pair of sharp talons saying that she found them in the Great Cave. The animals excitedly rush to find something for themselves. Zebra accompanies Tortoise and the Monkeys into the Cave where they discover the last remaining item; a plain black coat. The Monkeys persuade Zebra to try it on. By holding in his stomach, Zebra manages to get the coat on but it is extremely tight and the black coat starts to rip. In fact, the more Zebra eats the more the coat rips until Zebra has a stripy black and white coat which he is extremely proud of. Not only that, his new stripes make him very difficult to spot amongst the tall grasses of the plains. Finally, Zebra can eat as much grass as he likes and not be spotted by the other animals!

Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

programme.title: Iron Ball
programme.desc: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. While taking on the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that was planned for years and has to use his skills as an assassin to solve whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Elimination Game
programme.desc: Navy SEAL Rick is sentenced to rot in a military prison until he is offered the opportunity to put his life on the line and win his freedom in a kill or be killed reality show. Rick will have to eliminate some of the world's most notorious killers on live TV to gain his freedom and clear his name. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: The Ultimate BROcation
programme.desc: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. Season 2 features a first ever Thai female match and Season 3 has two Olympics gold medalists competing for the championship. This unique boxing show offers all-round entertainment, with live performances, lavish costumes and real fights with blood!

programme.title: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybri
programme.desc: Gabriella is driven by vengeance after a hybrid monster slaughters her family. On her quest, she joins a squad of Blood Hunters and together they wage war against ruthless underworld warlords, igniting a brutal showdown.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Retired auto worker, Korean War veteran and widower Walt Kowalski (Clint Eastwood) sets out to reform his neighbor, a young Hmong teenager, who tried to steal Kowalski's prized possession: a 1972 Ford Gran Torino he keeps in mint condition.

programme.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
programme.desc: Stone Age Earth: In the presence of a mysterious black obelisk, pre-humans discover the use of tools--and weapons--violently taking first steps toward intelligence. 1999: On Earth's moon astronauts uncover another mysterious black obelisk. 2001: Between Earth and Jupiter, the spacecraft's intelligent computer makes a mistake that kills most of the human crew--then continues to kill to hide its error. Beyond Time: The sole survivor of the journey to Jupiter ascends to the next level of humanity.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside us, it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In Billy Batson’s (Asher Angel) case, by shouting out one word—SHAZAM!—this streetwise 14-year-old foster kid can turn into the adult Super Hero Shazam (Zachary Levi), courtesy of an ancient wizard (Djimon Hounsou). Still a kid at heart—inside a ripped, godlike body—Shazam revels in this adult version of himself by doing what any teen would do with superpowers: have fun with them! Can he fly? Does he have X-ray vision? Can he shoot lightning out of his hands? Can he skip his social studies test? Shazam sets out to test the limits of his abilities with the joyful recklessness of a child. But he’ll need to master these powers quickly in order to fight the deadly forces of evil controlled by Dr. Thaddeus Sivana (Mark Strong).

programme.title: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: In CLASH OF THE TITANS, the ultimate struggle for power pits men against kings and kings against gods. But the war between the gods themselves could destroy the world. Sam Worthington (Terminator Salvation, Avatar) stars as the Greek hero Perseus in this spectacular retelling of the classic myth (and '80s cult classic film). Born of a god, but raised as a man, Perseus is helpless to save his family from the clutches of Hades (Oscar nominee Ralph Fiennes -- Harry Potter films), the vengeful god of the underworld. With nothing left to lose, he volunteers to lead a dangerous mission to defeat Hades before he can seize power from Zeus (Oscar nominee Liam Neeson -- Batman Begins) and unleash hell on earth. With a daring band of warriors, Perseus sets off on a perilous journey deep into forbidden worlds. Battling unholy demons and fearsome beasts, he will triumph only if he can accept his power as a god, defy his fate and create his own destiny.

programme.title: Run All Night
programme.desc: Lately, it seems Jimmy's only solace can be found at the bottom of a whiskey glass. But when Jimmy's estranged son, Mike (The Killing's Joel Kinnaman), becomes a target, Jimmy must make a choice between the crime family he chose and the real family he abandoned long ago. With Mike on the run, Jimmy's only penance for his past mistakes may be to keep his son from the same fate Jimmy is certain he'll face himself...at the wrong end of a gun. Now, with nowhere safe to turn, Jimmy just has one night to figure out exactly where his loyalties lie and to see if he can finally make things right.
